payload.core_mechanism_summary: Check if N is of form 2^r-1 (all ones binary) by testing powers of two; if so, output M = 2^{r-1}-1, special casing N=1 to output 2.
payload.rationale: Solves M^(M+1)=N using XOR property: consecutive integers XOR to a block of ones when M has trailing ones and a zero above, so N must be all ones. Implementation tests powers of two to reconstruct M.
